## Source
.design/m5/46-ozone-migration.md — REQ-1, AC-1 + decomposition PR 4.

## Surface
- `polaris-ozone-import/src/main.rs` — clap-derived CLI
- Subcommands: `import`, `verify`, `status`
- Modes: `--source dump://<path>` (file) or `--source live://<connection-string>` (live, future — flagged disabled in v2 if Q1 lands on A or C)
- Logging via `tracing` with structured fields

## Rust-quality notes
- Per rust-quality §3 (binary): `anyhow::Result<()>` at `main()`; `thiserror` for library boundaries.
- `#[derive(clap::Parser)]` on the args struct. Each subcommand is a variant of an `enum Command`.
- Progress reporting via `indicatif` (workspace dep — verify before adding). Falls back to plain `tracing::info!` lines if `--no-progress` is passed.
- Per rust-quality §10: the migration loop is `tokio::select!`-based with a `tokio::signal::ctrl_c()` branch that flips a `CancellationToken`. The batch loop checks the token between batches; never holds the transaction across the cancellation check.
- Per rust-quality §3: handle `--help`, `--version`, exit codes (0 = success, 1 = mapping errors > threshold, 2 = SIGINT-interrupted-clean, 3 = fatal).

## External references
- clap derive: https://docs.rs/clap/latest/clap/_derive/
- `tracing` + structured fields: https://docs.rs/tracing/latest/tracing/
- `indicatif` progress bars: https://docs.rs/indicatif/latest/indicatif/
- `tokio_util::sync::CancellationToken`: https://docs.rs/tokio-util/latest/tokio_util/sync/struct.CancellationToken.html

## Acceptance (AC-1)
- [ ] `polaris-ozone-import import --source <fixture-dump> --target <test-db>` populates the Polaris DB with subjects, reports, actions equivalent to the fixture.
- [ ] `polaris-ozone-import --help` shows all subcommands clearly.
- [ ] Wall-clock for the CI fixture migration: <30s (under typical CI hardware).
